candidates.title: The Runners Who Never Crossed the Line
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the charity race clock failed to record runners who clearly crossed the finish before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced the runners' timing tags but the missed finishes continued; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a metal banner frame beside the finish line was interfering with the timing antenna; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they moved the banner frame away and verified the gate using test tags before reopening, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Bags That Split at One Corner
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered every paper bag from the market stall tore at the same folded corner before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they used thicker paper but the next stack split along the same line; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized the bag-folding machine was scoring one crease too deeply and weakening the paper; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they adjusted the scoring wheel and tested the new bags with weighted parcels, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Books Trapped in the Return Chute
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the library return chute accepted books but none reached the collection basket before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they widened the outer opening but the books still piled up inside; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized a spring-loaded safety flap had been reattached backward after cleaning; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they closed the chute for repairs and restored the flap orientation before testing returns, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
